_comment: Template for deploy.py --config. Copy to a private, root-only path on the server and fill in. Never commit the filled copy (it names paths, containers, the n8n project and credential ids).

helper.data_dir: <host path of the n8n data volume folder holding state.sqlite and helper.py>
helper.runner_data_dir: <the same folder as seen inside the n8n container>

runner_env.WASET_SOCIAL_DATA_DIR: <the same folder as seen inside the n8n container>

n8n.file_dir: <host folder visible to the n8n container>
n8n.runner_file_dir: <the same folder as seen inside the n8n container>
